resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Destroyed circa 2009. The Montana lookouts page and the 2009 Arizona chapter report say the structure was removed under a demolition contract. The story uses the demolition wording that those two sources give and reports the firelookout.com wording.

sources.title: Liscom Butte Lookout - Mountain Bike & E-Bike Trail Guide

notes_for_editor: The brief's record (ground, 2009 removed, access unknown) holds except access. The USFS trail carries the lookout's name, so access is set to public for the trail; confirm the summit's status on the ground before any visit is suggested. The 1939 camp and 1958 cab come only from firelookout.com. The Arizona chapter report is a chapter newsletter, not a site survey. It does not define 'the area'. Its preceding paragraph describes the removal of Scenery Mountain Lookout (Kootenai NF, MT), which may be the other lookout lost in 2009, but the report does not say so. Edits 2026-10-10: 'managed the land' changed to 'listed under Custer National Forest' because the sources name the forest and do not say who managed the site; the Powder River County and Custer National Forest quotes were added to the evidence, as was the trail-data source line.
